contribution: Methods for empirically analysing imperfectly competitive markets: structural estimation of demand and supply with differentiated products. These tools are now used to study market power, mergers, pricing and productivity.
rationale: Recent prizes covered growth and innovation (2025), institutions (2024), labour (2023), banking (2022) and causal inference (2021), so empirical industrial organization stands out as a mature field not yet honoured. Berry, Levinsohn and Pakes's demand model (1995), along with Olley-Pakes and Ericson-Pakes, transformed antitrust practice and applied microeconomics. Their names recur on Clarivate and expert shortlists. This is an informed guess, not knowledge of the actual award.
